fights.notes: Papers reported a win for Allen; the referee's decision gave the prize money to McCoole. McCoole denies the referee was bribed and that his friends cut the ropes. Earlier pass said the place was near St. Louis; the text only has an unreadable 'St. a reece' in Hogan's letter.
